# v1.6.0 - Auto-complete everything, new quest alerts, game quest fix

### What's Changed

VenQuests can now run your whole quest list on its own, tell you when new quests show up, and the "play a game" quests report progress again.

- **Auto-complete all quests**: new Allow / Deny setting (default Deny). When allowed, every available quest is queued and completed one at a time with a 3 minute pause between quests
- **New quest alerts**: in-app pill plus optional desktop notification, with an Allow / Disallow switch and a "Send notification" test button
- **Fix**: play quests announce the spoofed game to Discord again and use the game's real executable name, so progress no longer stays at 0
- **Fix**: video quests retry enrollment with the other payloads Discord accepts instead of failing with "no longer available"
- **Rename**: the project is now vencord-quests and the plugin shows up as VenQuests
